name: Macquarie Park
notes: Primary Sydney hyperscaler cluster — AWS ap-southeast-2, Azure, Google, Oracle. Most constrained land in APAC.

name: Eastern Creek / Kemps Creek
notes: Western Sydney emerging campus zone. AWS and Azure announced builds. NEXTDC S7 (550MW) with OpenAI anchor. 40km from Macquarie Park via dark fibre.

name: Huntingwood
notes: Western Sydney M7 corridor. AirTrunk SYD1/2/3 campus cluster (130MW+). Blackstone acquisition (A$24B) validates sub-market. Good grid access via Blacktown industrial zone.

name: Erskine Park
notes: Western Sydney M7/M4 interchange. Stack SYD01 450MW SEARS filed (AU$650M). Digital Realty SYD10/11 operational. Large industrial land parcels with 132kV grid access.

name: Marulan / Goulburn
notes: Speculative AI stretch; renewable energy access via Snowy Hydro. ~180km from Sydney AZ — likely regional only.

name: Docklands / Port Melbourne
notes: Primary Melbourne hyperscaler cluster. Very constrained land. AWS ap-southeast-2 edge AZ.

name: Geelong
notes: 75km from Melbourne CBD. Renewable energy via Western Victoria wind corridor. Government-backed digital precinct proposed.

name: Moorabool / Lara
notes: Keppel Moorabool campus under development. 80km from Melbourne. Backed by renewable energy from Western Victoria. One of APAC's most significant AI campus sites.

name: Tullamarine
notes: Near Melbourne Airport. 22km from Docklands. Azure preference for disaster recovery AZ.

name: Jurong / Tuas
notes: Primary Singapore DC hub. Heavily constrained. Moratorium on new DC approvals. Highest $/kW in APAC.

name: Woodlands / Sembawang
notes: Northern Singapore, 30km from Jurong hub. Fibre to Johor via land cable. Limited land.

name: Iskandar / Nusajaya
notes: Singapore's AI campus hinterland. 30km from Jurong via JB-SG fibre. Massive hyperscaler commitments 2024-25. Most significant emerging AI site in APAC. Low power cost, large land.

name: Kulai / Senai
notes: 50km north of Singapore. YTL and AirTrunk campus development. Microsoft SEA AI campus announced. Power from Tenaga grid extension.

name: Cyberjaya
notes: Malaysia's primary DC hub, 30km south of KL. All major hyperscalers present. Fibre ring via AIMS.

name: Shah Alam / Klang
notes: 35km west of Cyberjaya. Industrial corridor. Emerging DC campus zone with large land parcels and grid capacity.

name: Ota / Shin-Kiba
notes: Primary Tokyo hyperscaler cluster. AWS ap-northeast-1, Azure Japan East. Very high density. Fibre from landing stations at Chikura/Ajigaura.

name: Inzai / Narita
notes: 40km northeast of Tokyo near Narita. Japan's premier hyperscale campus cluster — 'Data Centre Park' designation. Colt DCS Inzai 1-4 operational; Inzai 5 in planning. Keppel DC REIT acquired Tokyo DC3 (JPY 82.1B). Stack TKY01 (¥39.7B green loan). Hyperscaler 15-year leases standard.

name: Kawasaki / Yokohama
notes: 25km south of Tokyo CBD. Secondary AZ cluster. AWS and Azure DR sites. Good fibre connectivity to Ota via metro dark fibre ring.

name: Sagamihara / Machida
notes: 45km southwest of Tokyo. Emerging AI campus zone. Google pre-leased site. Lower land cost than core. Grid upgrade by TEPCO planned.

name: Atsugi / Ayase
notes: 60km west of Tokyo. Greenfield AI campus potential. Large industrial land. 110kV grid availability. Slower fibre buildout required.

name: Tseung Kwan O
notes: Primary HK DC hub. AWS ap-east-1, Azure and Google present. MEGA-i the largest single campus. Very constrained land.

name: Tuen Mun
notes: 40km northwest of TKO. Some emerging land capacity. Longer fibre run reduces cloud attractiveness. Political uncertainty weighs on investment.

name: Sangam / Mapo
notes: Primary Seoul DC cluster, Digital Media City adjacent. AWS ap-northeast-2, Azure, Google Cloud. High land cost.

name: Bundang / Pangyo
notes: 25km south of Seoul. Korea's Silicon Valley. AWS DR site. Good dark fibre to Sangam via metro ring.

name: Incheon / Songdo
notes: 50km west of Seoul near airport. Smart city infrastructure. Submarine cable landing station (KAWA). Google Incheon data centre. Growing AI campus potential.

name: Ibaraki / Takatsuki
notes: Primary Osaka hyperscaler cluster, 15km north of Osaka CBD. AWS ap-northeast-3, Azure Japan West. Significant campus expansion ongoing.

name: Sakai / Kishiwada
notes: 25km south of Osaka. Industrial zone. Renewable energy from Wakayama wind projects. Emerging AI campus zone with lower land costs.

name: Neihu / Nangang
notes: Primary Taipei DC cluster. AWS ap-east-2 (TW). Constrained by dense urban build. Key for Taiwan Strait geopolitical monitoring.

name: Taoyuan
notes: 35km west near airport. Oracle and Azure DR sites. Submarine cable landing nearby (TW-1, APG). Emerging campus zone. Power from Taoyuan grid.

name: Navi Mumbai / Airoli
notes: Primary Mumbai hyperscaler cluster. AWS ap-south-1, Azure, Google Cloud ap-south1. HIRANANDANI campus the largest single DC campus in India.

name: Taloja / Khopoli
notes: 35km south of Navi Mumbai. Large Yotta campus. Power from MSEDCL grid. Emerging cloud stretch and AI campus zone for Mumbai.

name: Pune
notes: 160km from Mumbai. Separate IT hub. Cheaper land and power. AI campus potential as standalone market, less relevant as Mumbai stretch.

name: Noida / Greater Noida
notes: Primary Delhi NCR hyperscaler cluster. AWS ap-south-2, Azure India Central. 30km east of Delhi. Most active DC construction market in India.

name: Gurgaon / Manesar
notes: 30km south of Delhi. IT hub. Azure and Google DR sites. Power from Haryana grid. Second DC cluster emerging alongside Noida.

name: HITEC City / Gachibowli
notes: Primary Hyderabad IT and DC hub. AWS ap-south-2 DR, Azure South India, Google Cloud ap-south2. Low land cost vs Mumbai/Delhi. Strong government support (T-Hub).

name: Genome Valley / Kompally
notes: 25km north of HITEC City. Emerging pharmaceutical/biotech zone with grid capacity. Large land parcels available at low cost. Telangana State incentive scheme applies.

name: Cibinong / Sentul
notes: Primary Jakarta DC cluster, 40km south. AWS ap-southeast-3, Azure, Google Cloud ap-southeast-3. DCI the dominant operator. Grid capacity improving.

name: Bekasi / Karawang
notes: 25km east of Jakarta CBD. Industrial corridor. Oracle Jakarta DC. Power from PLN East Java corridor. Land available at competitive cost.

name: Banten / Cilegon
notes: 100km west of Jakarta. Industrial estate near Krakatau Steel power plant. Very low power cost. Greenfield AI campus potential with significant power access.

name: Taguig / BGC
notes: Primary Manila DC cluster. BGC financial district. AWS ap-southeast-1 edge. Fibre from landing stations at Nasugbu. Grid reliability improving.

name: Alabang / Muntinlupa
notes: 25km south of BGC. Emerging residential-commercial zone. STT GDC campus. Power from Meralco South grid. Lower land cost than BGC.

name: Clark / Pampanga
notes: 100km north of Manila in Clark Freeport Zone. BCDA digital zone. Oracle announced campus. Very low land cost. Power from Clark grid. 75MW available power. Renewable energy target.

name: Nonthaburi / Bang Yai
notes: Primary Bangkok DC cluster, 15km northwest of CBD. AWS ap-southeast-1 edge, Azure, Google. Fibre from CAT Telecom ring. Limited land.

name: EEC / Chonburi
notes: 100km east of Bangkok in Eastern Economic Corridor. Major government investment zone. GULF INNOTECH and WHA industrial estate DCs. AWS and Google announced sites. Power from EEC grid upgrade. Very significant AI campus development zone.

name: Thu Duc / District 7
notes: Primary HCMC DC cluster. Thu Duc Smart City zone. AWS new region planned. Azure and Google present. Fibre from Vung Tau submarine cable landing. Grid being upgraded.

name: Binh Duong
notes: 30km north of HCMC. Vietnam's largest industrial zone. CMC DC campus. Power from EVN grid. Land at very competitive cost. Government incentives for digital infrastructure.

name: Long An
notes: 50km southwest of HCMC. Government-backed digital zone. Very low land cost. Power from Mekong delta grid. Greenfield AI campus potential. Slow permitting is key risk.

name: Albany / North Shore
notes: Primary Auckland DC cluster, 20km north of CBD. AWS ap-southeast-2 edge. Azure and Microsoft present. Limited by NZ grid and high capex cost.

name: South Auckland / Wiri
notes: 20km south of Auckland CBD. Industrial zone. Power from Vector Wiri substation. Land available. Limited hyperscaler interest to date but growing.
